newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Fujian Industrial Bank raises loan to US$28 mln.
newsitem.headline: Fujian Industrial Bank raises loan to US$28 mln.

text.p: Fujian Industrial Bank's one-year loan facility has been increased to US$28 million from US$20 million in syndication, arranger Standard Chartered Investment Banking said.
The loan pays a margin of 30 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate. With fees, the all-in return to top-tier managers is 75 basis points.
Arranger and lead manager Standard Chartered Investment Banking committed US$2.5 million.

Co-arrangers and lead managers are Australia and New Zealand Banking Group, Bayerische Landesbank Girozentrale Hong Kong and Industrial Bank of Japan, with US$2.5 million each, and ABN AMRO Bank Shanghai Branch, Norinchukin Bank, United Overseas Bank and Westdeutsche Landesbank Girozentrale, with US$2 million each.
Co-lead managers, with US$2 million each, are Bank Brussels Lambert Hong Kong, U.S. Bank, Baden-Wurttembergische Bank, Credito Italiano Hong Kong and Dongnam Finance (Hong Kong).
